column1: # The client frame sctk-adwaita 0.10.1 drew before LW.5 (MIT, Copyright (c)
# (L-HEADER-LW7, lw5-button-layout-shadow) from the crate's own buttons.rs,
# config.rs, theme.rs and shadow.rs. layout: GNOME's button-layout value as
# config.rs read it through dbus-send (<no portal>: none), the read's two
# sides (read=left|right, - for none), the compositor's capabilities, and
# the buttons each side shows left to right. shadow: the alpha shadow.rs
# paints across a border part from the window outward, along its middle
# line. size: the frame's sizes in logical px.
